claim: With hundreds of concurrent durable commits, dedicated log writer threads take the redo writes and syncs off the user threads: throughput rises.
note: 2026-11-04 (atvbmamd, 512 threads): ON +88% tps, but redo fsyncs per transaction rose 5x (0.018 -> 0.096): the dedicated threads win by taking the work off the user threads and syncing in parallel with the writes, not by fewer syncs. The fewer-syncs expectation is dropped; rerun on another host to confirm the gain.
